# Preprocessing function
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text)
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        try:
            text = literal_eval(text)
        except:
            text = text[1:-1]
    try:
        text = text.encode().decode("unicode_escape")
    except:
        pass
    return text


# Feature extraction function with punctuation density feature
def extract_text_features(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        text = ""
    text = str(text)

    # Clean text
    cleaned = text
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        try:
            cleaned = literal_eval(text)
        except:
            cleaned = text[1:-1]
    try:
        cleaned = cleaned.encode().decode("unicode_escape")
    except:
        pass

    # Text features
    features = {
        "length": len(cleaned),
        "word_count": len(cleaned.split()),
        "exclamation_count": cleaned.count("!"),
        "question_count": cleaned.count("?"),
        "uppercase_ratio": sum(1 for c in cleaned if c.isupper())
        / max(len(cleaned), 1),
        "digit_ratio": sum(1 for c in cleaned if c.isdigit()) / max(len(cleaned), 1),
        "space_ratio": sum(1 for c in cleaned if c.isspace()) / max(len(cleaned), 1),
    }

    # Profanity count
    text_lower = cleaned.lower()
    profanity_count = sum(1 for word in PROFANITY_WORDS if word in text_lower)
    features["profanity_count"] = profanity_count

    # Repeated character ratio
    repeated_char_count = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(cleaned):
        j = i
        while j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j] == cleaned[i]:
            j += 1
        if j - i >= 3:
            repeated_char_count += j - i
        i = j
    features["repeated_char_ratio"] = repeated_char_count / max(len(cleaned), 1)

    # Shouting word ratio
    words = cleaned.split()
    shouting_words = 0
    total_words = 0
    for word in words:
        clean_word = "".join(c for c in word if c.isalpha())
        if clean_word:
            total_words += 1
            if clean_word.isupper() and clean_word.lower() not in COMMON_WORDS:
                shouting_words += 1
    features["shouting_word_ratio"] = shouting_words / max(total_words, 1)

    # Negative sentiment word ratio
    negative_word_count = sum(1 for word in NEGATIVE_WORDS if word in text_lower)
    features["negative_sentiment_ratio"] = negative_word_count / max(total_words, 1)

    # NEW FEATURE: Punctuation density (ratio of all punctuation to total chars)
    punctuation_count = sum(1 for c in cleaned if c in string.punctuation)
    features["punctuation_density"] = punctuation_count / max(len(cleaned), 1)

    return features


# Apply cleaning
train_df["Comment_Clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Extract text features
train_features = train_df["Comment"].apply(extract_text_features)

X_train_text = np.array(
    [
        [
            feat["length"],
            feat["word_count"],
            feat["exclamation_count"],
            feat["question_count"],
            feat["uppercase_ratio"],
            feat["digit_ratio"],
            feat["space_ratio"],
            feat["profanity_count"],
            feat["repeated_char_ratio"],
            feat["shouting_word_ratio"],
            feat["negative_sentiment_ratio"],
            feat["punctuation_density"],  # NEW FEATURE
        ]
        for feat in train_features
    ]
)
X_test_text = np.array(
    [
        [
            feat["length"],
            feat["word_count"],
            feat["exclamation_count"],
            feat["question_count"],
            feat["uppercase_ratio"],
            feat["digit_ratio"],

            feat["negative_sentiment_ratio"],
            feat["punctuation_density"],  # NEW FEATURE
        ]
        for feat in test_features
    ]
)

# Feature Engineering: TF-IDF with Word and Char n-grams
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=10000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    dtype=np.float32,
)

char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=10000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    dtype=np.float32,
)

# Fit and transform
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_train_tfidf = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])

X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_test_tfidf = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# Convert text features to sparse and combine with TF-IDF
X_train_text_sparse = csr_matrix(X_train_text)
X_test_text_sparse = csr_matrix(X_test_text)

# Combine all features
X_train = hstack([X_train_tfidf, X_train_text_sparse])
X_test = hstack([X_test_tfidf, X_test_text_sparse])
y_train = train_df["Insult"]

# Train/Validation Split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Model 1: LinearSVC with Calibration
base_clf_svc = LinearSVC(
    C=1.0,
    max_iter=5000,
    loss="hinge",
    penalty="l2",
    dual=True,
    random_state=42,
    class_weight="balanced",
)
clf_svc = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf_svc, method="isotonic", cv=3)
clf_svc.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
val_preds_svc = clf_svc.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# Model 2: Logistic Regression
clf_lr = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=42, class_weight="balanced", solver="lbfgs"
)
clf_lr.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
val_preds_lr = clf_lr.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# Model 3: SGDClassifier with log loss
clf_sgd = SGDClassifier(
    loss="log_loss",
    max_iter=5000,
    random_state=42,
    class_weight="balanced",
    penalty="l2",
    alpha=0.0001,
)
clf_sgd.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
val_preds_sgd = clf_sgd.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# Grid search for optimal ensemble weights
best_auc = 0
best_weights = (0.33, 0.33, 0.34)

for w1 in np.arange(0.0, 1.01, 0.1):
    for w2 in np.arange(0.0, 1.01 - w1, 0.1):
        w3 = 1.0 - w1 - w2
        if w3 < 0:
            continue
        val_preds_ensemble = w1 * val_preds_svc + w2 * val_preds_lr + w3 * val_preds_sgd
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds_ensemble)
        if auc > best_auc:
            best_auc = auc
            best_weights = (w1, w2, w3)

print(
    f"Best weights: LinearSVC={best_weights[0]:.2f}, LR={best_weights[1]:.2f}, SGD={best_weights[2]:.2f}"
)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {best_auc}")

# Retrain on full training data for final submission
clf_svc.fit(X_train, y_train)
clf_lr.fit(X_train, y_train)
clf_sgd.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict on test set with optimal ensemble
test_preds_svc = clf_svc.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
test_preds_lr = clf_lr.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
test_preds_sgd = clf_sgd.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
test_preds_ensemble = (
    best_weights[0] * test_preds_svc
    + best_weights[1] * test_preds_lr
    + best_weights[2] * test_preds_sgd
)

# Prepare submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Insult": test_preds_ensemble,
        "Comment": test_df["Comment"],
        "Date": test_df["Date"],
    }
)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
